attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (Connecticut State Dental Commission)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, including online, offered or approved by the ADA and affiliated state/local dental societies, national/state dental specialty organizations, the Academy of General Dentistry, hospitals, CODA-accredited or regionally accredited schools, CODA-recognized agencies, medical associations, state/local health departments or ACGME; DPH does not pre-approve courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first license renewal.
rules.alternatives: 8 hours of volunteer dental practice at a public health facility = 1 contact hour, max 10 contact hours per 24 months. Waiver/extension for medical disability; exemption for licensees not in active practice (notarized application before the period ends).
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; keep certificates at least 3 years and send them within 45 days if DPH asks.

topics.who: Infection control in a dental setting
Prescribing controlled substances and pain management

rules.notes: 25 h within the 24 months before renewal (license renews yearly). Also 1 h each in any 3 of DPH's 10 topics (record keeping/risk management, access to care, HIPAA, medical emergencies incl. CPR, sexual assault/domestic abuse, cultural competence, veterans' mental health, diagnostic technology…). Online OK.
